items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, you know who that is, don't you? Ray Anthony. Yes, sir.

ctx.x: All right. This is whose band? Is this Johnny Long? Mm-hmm. Johnny Long's band. This is the first band that were playing there when we first went there. All the guys in the band were just as fine a fellas as you ever met. And Long had his head so high in the air he never realized anyone was living. All the standard chalky members from that period. But he had a fine band, Long had his head. Mm-hmm. We had a good band too, boy. Oh, yeah.
Now, you know who that is, don't you? Ray Anthony. Yes, sir. Was he at the Blue Room or someplace? Oh, yeah.

Then he was at the Peabody Hotel. Now, this band, there's Billy Neuberger. Mm-hmm. Al Bernard Senior. I don't know this guy. Tony Fougerat, Frank Tolke, and Marshall Farrell. Now, we had a very nice little band there.
